transcription.text: and that is why it was named Merah. The people grumbled to Moses,
"What are we going to drink?" So he cried out to the Lord and the Lord showed him a tree
and he threw it into the water and the water became drinkable.
The Lord made a statue, an ordinance for them at Merah
and he tested them there. He said, "If you will carefully obey the Lord your God,
do what is right in his sight, pay attention to his commands
and keep his statutes, I will not inflict
any illnesses on you that I have inflicted on the Egyptians,
for I am the Lord who heals you." Then they came to Elam
where there were 12 springs and 20 date palms
and they camped there by the water. The entire Israelite community departed from
and came to the wilderness of Sin which is between
Elam and Sinai. And on the 15th day,
on the second month after they had left the land of Egypt.
